statement: Directed PCT interleaving hunt on the DT6-hosted REAL RebalanceCoordinator + OperationWorkflowOwner finds-or-bounds safety-invariant breaches on two targets: (1) the self-documented over-removal seam in projectQuorumAfterRemoval (the optimistic recoveryProjectionNodeIds node-union on the completion-safe floor path) and (2) source-removal-only-after-target-durably-active drain ordering. Terminal is BINARY: a minimized seed that deterministically breaches the invariant with red-on-revert proof, OR a bounded 'no breach at PCT depth <= D over >= N seeds' negative. This is the dst-cost-model-circle epic's Option-A (safety / design-bug) lane and makes NO scenario passRate / cost-model fidelity claim.

constraints.statement: This quest must not make or depend on any scenario passRate, root-cause-label, or cost-model fidelity claim. Reproducing the rolling-restart rate is REFUTED for the safety lane and is the fidelity-spike's exclusive concern. Any drift toward 'make the sweep match docker' is out of scope.
Invariant breaches may only be sampled on settled state via driveNetworkFine + onSettled. A violation observed mid-drive (drive-granularity artifact) is NOT a bug and must not be reported as one.

Every claimed breach must be minimized (minimizePctDepth) and red-on-revert proven (npm run dt:prove) before it is called a bug. A bounded 'no breach at depth <= D over >= N seeds' is a valid terminal; do not escalate depth without limit to manufacture a hit.

Before Step B, confirm no existing quest/test already covers the target seam: operation-workflow-drain-redrive (SOLVED; was drain re-drive UNMASK / liveness, not removal-safety) and membership-publication-drain-determinism (publication drain, not rebalancer removal). Do not re-run covered ground.
If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
